title: $100 A MONTH
subtitle: OVER 30 YEARS
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: Imagine you save one hundred dollars a month. For thirty years. Where you put it changes everything. In a savings account, you end with thirty-eight thousand. Barely more than you put in. In bonds, a little better. In gold, better still. But in the stock market, that same hundred dollars a month becomes over two hundred thousand dollars. Same effort. Same money. Six times the result. The difference isn't income. It's the choice.
